title: Wonder Woman #799 DC 2023 Yanick Paquette Cover Becky Cloonan Michael Conrad
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Wonder Woman #799 (August 2023), DC Comics - "Leading the way... for peace and justice." Written by Becky Cloonan and Michael W. Conrad, with art by Alitha Martinez, Meghan Hetrick, Juan Ferreyra, Terry and Rachel Dodson and Paulina Ganucheau; cover by Yanick Paquette and Nathan Fairbairn. $4.99 cover price.

Back cover: The Flash movie (June 16) poster ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
